newsitem.title: USA: Analytical Surveys names Corder chairman.
newsitem.headline: Analytical Surveys names Corder chairman.

text.p: Analytical Surveys Inc said that its president and chief executive officer, Sidney Corder, has been elected chairman of the board of directors.

Corder, who has served as the company's president since 1990 and its CEO since 1993, replaces former chairman John Thorpe, who has stepped down as part of his previously announced plans to reduce his day-to-day role at the company.
Analytical Surveys provides data conversion services and products for municipal, utility, government and commercial customers.
